They capture breadth (touch-based scoring), depth (receiving integration via TPRR), market dynamics (total over/under mapping), and risk (injury status). The projected_touches operator normalizes fantasy production against salary, addressing budget constraints. The tprr_adjustment quantifies evolving roles, crucial for players like Javonte Williams who see increased pass-catching opportunities. The total_over_under maps game context onto expected performance, accounting for defensive strength. Finally, the injury_status_indicator provides a binary check for reliability. These operators form a unified mathematical framework that can be integrated into larger models for player selection.
